title: Scrum-Master Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the scrum-master advisory persona: an epic/story-decomposition input paired with its expected decomposition judgment. Each line of evals/scrum-master/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The persona judges whether a plan is well decomposed/sequenced and lands a concrete recommendation, so the expected decision is decomposition-shaped (decomposition / recommend) — NOT the triage {escalate, risk} shape of evals/case.schema.json. This is the trust anchor for the persona's skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case. Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and what grounds the expected decomposition judgment.

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the planning concern a case exercises ('decomposition', 'acceptance-criteria', 'sequencing', 'negative').

input.description: The pre-fetched review context exactly as the advisory consumes it: a self-contained description of the epic/story plan under review.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected decomposition judgment the persona must produce for this plan.

decomposition.description: Whether the plan is adequately decomposed ('good') or must be split into smaller PR-sized units ('too-coarse'). A well-decomposed plan with a different flaw (e.g. a missing AC or a DAG cycle) is still 'good' on decomposition; the flaw lands in `recommend`.

recommend.description: The concrete recommendation the advisory must land (how to decompose, sequence, or specify the plan).
